suggestions.rationale: Clinical Mapping Master Batch 2026 publishes this relationship only as temporal association risk. Require gout before incident abdominal aortic aneurysm and separately established AAA; assess smoking, age, hypertension, atherosclerosis, and other aneurysm risks. Population-based cohort association; no causal or aggravation inference. The cited literature supports only this bounded proposition and does not, by itself, establish an individual medical nexus.
